Hello! My Name is Marcus and I am a Self-Proclaimed Web Developer with too much free time. (Please hire me)

I'm currently 26 years old. I specialize in exploring new web technologies. Although I have some experience with backend, I mostly concentrate on the frontend since it's the most accessible stack to work on.
I am lazy enough to streamline my workflow to automation but not too lazy to submit to AI. Although AI is useful for being a cool encyclopedia, I wouldn't fully integrate my codebases to generative AI.
Too many pitfalls to encounter.

My Hobbies include but not limited to coding, watching tokusatsu, and playing Magic: The Gathering.

My code setup usually looks like this:



I have Node.js installed to test and run this very webpage locally. I also have the Live Server extension to run locally but there is more flexibility running via Node.js using Vite for Hot Reloading.

I watch a bunch of Tokusatsu, especially during Sundays to match Japan Simulcast. Typically, Kamen rider is my go-to favorite Series. I'm currently watching ZEZTZ as it's the current rider series airing.
Fortunately, It is easier to watch the series this year as they allow simulcast to certain regions. (Ahoy 🏴‍☠️).

Speaking of ZEZTZ, I actaully bought one of their DX toys:



It's basically a transformation device for the user to envelop their battle armour. In this version, the user harnesses the power of their dreams and nightmares.
Any "impossible " Abilities done on dreams can be achieved in real life. It's like super lucid dreaming. Every Year Kamen Rider sticks to a theme and develops their story around thoses attributes.

Here's another hobby that I participate:



I play Magic: the Gathering and mainly play the commander format. I used to play standard where it's a 60 card constructed format. My peers groups mainly plays commander, a 100 card singleton constructed format that follows your commander's color identity.
Typically, constructed decks lets you use multiples of up to four copies. In this commander format, your commander is your guide to build around for your deck. You create synergies and combos around the commander's attributes.

In this case, I run 'The Mycotyrant' . I was mainly inspired by the deck list created by JLK from Game Knights because of this specific interaction.

Also, I love graveyard interactions! It's like my extension to my hand. There are also some weaknesses to this deck such as exile effects and only getting value during your turn.
For the deck list, here's the deck list if you're interested! (Updates may occur since I just got upgrades from the Secrets of Strixhaven set!)

I think that's all I could share about me. Thank you!
